statements.status_notes: The BuildKit image includes runc, which brings in golang.org/x/net. The vulnerability is in golang.org/x/net/idna, but runc only imports golang.org/x/net/bpf from this module, so the affected idna package and ToASCII/ToUnicode functions are not present in the BuildKit image.
